body:
This issue https://github.com/remix-run/react-router/issues/10579 shares some good insights about why some apps struggle with `startTransition`. 

[React-router 6.13.0](https://github.com/remix-run/react-router/releases/tag/react-router%406.13.0) also provided a feature flag but recommended apps to adopt it sooner to better support concurrent mode. Unfortunately Remix opt-in to this flat automatically and doesn't provide the Remix users a feature flat to opt-out.
